description: Retail restructuring conference call with historical metrics, capex disclosure, and an explicit no-guidance statement.
current_transcript: Operator: Welcome to the Horizon Retail Brands third quarter 2026 corporate update conference call. For the third quarter of 2026, total net sales were $85 million. Capital expenditures for the period were $12 million dedicated to store optimization. Management is not providing forward-looking financial guidance or targets for future quarters at this time. Our operational priority remains store portfolio rationalization and inventory discipline.
